cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: A quiet dining alcove in a medieval river inn with a lamp on the table and a dark gothic window — She has ordered a whole spiced orange and watches the rising steam after opening its shell; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a Guan Yu temple — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a convention photo zone under ring lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — sets a small hand lantern down on the ground beside her; a misty enchanted garden of moss — lying on her front; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — standing; a self-service car wash bay — standing; a hotel suite with a city view and an open suitcase — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — holds a book closed against her chest; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — kneeling on the ground; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height
